content.text:
Native ACE tools (`plugin-plugin-ace`), grouped as requested:

### Browser (`ace_browser_*`)
| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ace_browser_open` | Open this thread’s ACE browser |
| `ace_browser_close` | Close this thread’s ACE browser |
| `ace_browser_navigate` | Navigate to a URL |
| `ace_browser_snapshot` | Accessibility tree + element refs |
| `ace_browser_tabs` | List / open / switch / close tabs |
| `ace_browser_click` | Click a snapshot ref |
| `ace_browser_type` | Replace text in an editable ref |
| `ace_browser_press` | Playwright key presses |
| `ace_browser_scroll` | Scroll by pixel deltas |
| `ace_browser_hover` | Hover over a ref |
| `ace_browser_focus` | Focus a ref |
| `ace_browser_drag` | Drag ref → ref |
| `ace_browser_select` | Select options in a native `<select>` |
| `ace_browser_check` / `ace_browser_uncheck` | Checkbox / radio |
| `ace_browser_upload` | Set file input from workspace/artifacts |
| `ace_browser_dialog` | Accept/dismiss pending dialogs |
| `ace_browser_find` | Find elements by role + name |
| `ace_browser_wait_for` | Wait for URL, text, or ref visibility |
| `ace_browser_evaluate` | Run JS in the page |
| `ace_browser_screenshot` | Screenshot |
| `ace_browser_resize` / `ace_browser_emulate` | Viewport / device emulation |
| `ace_browser_logs` / `ace_browser_network_body` | Console, network, response bodies |
| `ace_browser_record_start` / `ace_browser_record_stop` | Record to thread artifact |

### Screen (`screen_*`)
| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `screen_ui_tree` | Bounded a11y tree + refs (preferred first step) |
| `screen_ui_find` | Find elements by role/name/text |
| `screen_ui_act` | Act on a ref via OS accessibility API |
| `screen_screenshot` | Visual check (<ENV>er token cost) |
| `screen_click` / `screen_type` / `screen_key` / `screen_scroll` | Coordinate / legacy input |
| `screen_paste` | Paste while preserving clipboard |
| `screen_request_app` | Request approval for a bundle ID |
| `screen_open_app` | Launch app + agent session |
| `screen_request_foreground` | Request foreground / real focus |

### Device (`device_*`)
| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `device_list` | List emulators/simulators and status |
| `device_boot` / `device_start` / `device_stop` | Boot, start capture, stop capture |
| `device_ui_tree` / `device_find` / `device_act` | A11y tree, search, actions |
| `device_screenshot` | Device screenshot |
| `device_tap` / `device_swipe` / `device_type` / `device_key` | Touch, swipe, typing, keys |
| `device_open_app` / `device_open_url` / `device_install` | App, URL, package install |
| `device_logs` | Tail device logs |
| `device_record_start` / `device_record_stop` | Screen recording artifact |

### Agent / handoff
| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ace_thread_info` | This thread + canonical status |
| `ace_list_agents` | Page the thread’s agent tree |
| `ace_spawn_agent` | Request a child agent |
| `delegate_task` | Delegate to an independent child thread |
| `ace_read_handoff` / `ace_read_handoff_chunk` | Page cited handoff history / streams |
| `ace_thread_handoff` | Git worktree handoff for owned thread |
| `ace_thread_create` / `ace_thread_launch` | Create child thread, then launch with task |
| `ace_thread_message` / `ace_thread_wait` / `ace_thread_read` / `ace_thread_read_output` | Follow-ups, wait, transcript paging |
| `ace_thread_search` / `ace_thread_interrupt` / `ace_thread_fork` / `ace_thread_merge` | Search, interrupt, fork, merge |
| `ace_thread_rename` / `ace_thread_regenerate_title` / `ace_thread_link_pr` | Title, PR link |
| `ace_thread_settle` / `ace_thread_snooze` | Archive when settled, snooze notifications |
| `ace_queue_edit` / `ace_queue_reorder` | Edit/reorder queued input |
| `ace_question_answer` | Answer pending questions on owned thread |
| `ace_notify_user` | Post notice + request notification |
| `ace_preview_list` / `ace_preview_close` | Preview servers on a thread |
| `ace_project_read` | Workspace project metadata |

---

### `ace_thread_info` (called once)

| Field | Value |
|--------|--------|
| **Thread ID** | `dce93594-8541-4352-9657-8ee7fb600f2e` |
| **Title** | Development thread |
| **Provider** | codex |
| **Workspace ID** | `548ad906-e828-48e1-b0a0-53622a34cfee` |
| **Status** | `new` |
| **Root agent** | `root` |
| **Live** | provider `codex`, `subagentCount: 0` |
